chunks: He narrated - Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Dirraj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) granted the grandfather one-sixth.

key_terms.أَطْعَمَ: Granted/Gave (in the context of inheritance share)
key_terms.السُّدُسَ: One-sixth (a specific fractional share in inheritance law)

ai.seo_question: What share of inheritance does the grandfather receive according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the grandfather's fixed share of one-sixth (suds) in inheritance, a ruling attributed directly to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a foundational precedent for the grandfather's position among the 'residual' heirs (Ahl al-Furud), often discussed in relation to whether he receives a fixed portion or the remainder depending on the presence of other heirs like the father. The narration highlights the continuity of prophetic legal tradition as preserved by the Imams, specifically linking the grandfather's entitlement to the broader framework of inheritance distribution outlined in the Quran.
